top_jobs.job: When the affiliate payout is due Friday, help me see which commissions are for orders that were returned, cancelled, fake or from past buyers, so I pay only for new sales that happened and stayed
top_jobs.metric: commission paid on returned, cancelled or returning-buyer orders, per month

top_jobs.job: When a creator's post outsells our studio ads, help me run it as a partnership ad, find more creators like them and pay a fair rate with the rights in writing, so I get proven ads cheaper than a new shoot
top_jobs.metric: cost per new customer of partnership ads vs our own brand ads

top_jobs.job: When the Amazon agency reports record ad sales but the payout barely moved, help me see what ads cost against profit after Amazon fees and stop the spend that loses money, so I stop growing sales that lose money
top_jobs.metric: Amazon ad spend as a share of Amazon profit before ads, per ASIN

top_jobs.job: When the month closes and ad spend sits across 6 platforms and new ones pitch for budget, help me see one true total against budget and bills, and test a new channel only with a stop line, so I pay only for what works
top_jobs.metric: invoice gaps found and recovered, and spend vs budget across all platforms

jobs.job: Match every commission to its store order before Friday's payout, and hold those for returned, cancelled, test or duplicate orders

inputs.need: commission report for the payout period
inputs.from: affiliate network such as Impact, ShareASale or Refersion

inputs.need: orders with refunds, cancels and codes

steps: Pull the commission report and the matching orders
Mark each row: kept, returned, cancelled, test or duplicate
Hold pay on rows still inside the return window
Reverse commissions on orders refunded after the last payout
A person reviews any hold over $200 before it is sent
jobs.output: a payout file with held and reversed rows and the dollars saved
jobs.next: feeds 13-04 (rates by new buyer share) and 21-finance-cash

watch.metric: commission paid on returned or cancelled orders

jobs.job: Check any partner whose orders jump 3 times in a week before paying: order source, click to order time, new vs returning, repeated address or card
jobs.trigger: when a partner's weekly orders are 3 times their 8 week average

inputs.need: partner clicks and orders by day
orders with address, payment and new vs returning

steps: Flag the partner and freeze their pending commission
Check click to order time: under 10 seconds on many orders points to cookie stuffing
Check repeated addresses, cards or emails and the share of returning buyers
Ask the partner where the traffic came from and log the answer
Release, cut or remove, and write the reason
jobs.output: a checked partner with a release or cut decision and the reason

watch.metric: commission paid to flagged partners before checks

jobs.job: Find creator codes leaked to coupon sites and stop paying commission on buyers who found the code at checkout
jobs.trigger: weekly scan, and when code orders jump

inputs.need: a scan of top coupon sites for our codes
inputs.from: a person, 20 minutes, or a code tool

steps: List every code used in the last 30 days with orders and new buyer share
Search our brand on the top 5 coupon sites and note which codes appear
For leaked codes, retire them and give the creator a new unique code or link
Set commission on leaked-code orders to zero from the leak date if the terms allow
Tell the creator in plain words and log it
jobs.output: a list of leaked codes retired and commission saved per month

watch.metric: orders on leaked codes

jobs.job: Set commission rates by who brings new buyers: more for creators and content partners with high new buyer share, less for coupon and loyalty sites

inputs.need: 90 days of partner orders with new vs returning

steps: Compute new buyer share and profit after commission per partner
Group partners into 3 tiers by new buyer share
Set a rate per tier that keeps first order profit above the floor
Founder signs the table
Send 30 days notice with the new terms and the reason
jobs.output: a 3 tier commission table with the profit check for each tier

watch.metric: share of commission paid on new buyers

jobs.job: Catch affiliates bidding on our brand name in Google, stop them and claw back the commission

inputs.need: brand search screenshots on phone and desktop

steps: Search our brand name and top product names and screenshot any ad not ours
Match the display URL or tracking link to a partner
Send the terms and ask them to stop in 48 hours
Reverse commission on orders from those clicks if the terms allow
Recheck the next week and log
jobs.output: a log of brand bidders caught, stopped and commission recovered

watch.metric: partner ads on brand terms

jobs.drives: brand clicks we stop paying twice for

jobs.job: Find 30 people already posting about us for free and rank them by fit, engagement and whether they bought more than once

inputs.need: tagged posts and mentions on Instagram
creator fit rules: niche, tone, audience

steps: Pull the last 90 days of tags, mentions and photo reviews
Match names to customers to see who bought and how often
Score each on fit, engagement rate and repeat buying
A person watches the top 30 posts and drops any off-brand ones
Add the top 15 to the roster with the reason
jobs.output: a ranked list of 30 free fans, top 15 on the roster with notes

watch.metric: creators on the roster who already buy

jobs.job: Run the 5 best creator posts as partnership ads through the creator's handle, head to head with our best brand ad

inputs.need: creator posts with written usage rights and partnership ad permission
our best brand ad of the last 30 days
allowed claims to check the creator's caption

steps: Pick 5 posts with the best organic hold rate and saves
Get written rights for 60 or 90 days and the partnership ad permission
Check each caption against allowed claims and fix what is not true
Launch in one ad set with our best brand ad as control, same budget each
Read at 14 days on cost per new customer
Move winners into the main ad set and log the result on the roster
jobs.output: a live partnership ad test with the winner named at day 14

watch.metric: cost per new customer, partnership ads vs brand ad

jobs.drives: new customers at a lower cost

jobs.job: Price a creator's quote against what the same reach and clicks would cost in paid ads, and send a fair offer
jobs.trigger: each time a creator sends a quote

inputs.need: the creator's last 10 posts with views, saves and link clicks, from their insights screenshots
audience country, age and fake follower check
inputs.from: an audit tool or a manual look

inputs.need: our cost per 1,000 views and cost per new customer for that audience

steps: Take the median views of the last 10 posts, not the best one
Check the audience is in our countries and age band, and not bots
Price the same views at our paid cost per 1,000
Add value for usage rights if we will run it as an ad
Send an offer with a base fee and a bonus per sale on their code
jobs.output: a priced offer for each creator quote, with the math on one line

watch.metric: fee paid per 1,000 real views vs paid media

jobs.job: Write one creator brief per winning principle: the hook, the pain, the proof, the do-not-say list, 3 example openings and cuts at 15, 30 and 45 seconds with raw footage

inputs.need: briefs that worked and failed before

steps: Pick the 3 principles behind our best ads this quarter
Write one brief per principle with 3 example opening lines
Add the do-not-say list and the proof they may show
Ask for 15, 30 and 45 second cuts plus raw clips we can recut
Founder reads the brief once before it goes out
jobs.output: 3 creator briefs, each tied to a principle that already won

watch.metric: share of creator videos usable as ads without a reshoot

jobs.job: Track each creator's posts, code orders, partnership ad results and rights end date on one roster, and renew or cut each month

inputs.need: code and link orders per creator

steps: Update each creator's posts delivered, orders, new buyers and fees
Compute cost per new customer per creator across organic and ads
Mark renew, test again or cut
List rights ending in the next 30 days
Send renewals and cut notes
jobs.output: a monthly roster with renew, retest or cut on every creator

watch.metric: cost per new customer per creator

jobs.drives: money moves to creators who sell

jobs.job: Check the rights end date on every live creator ad each week and renew or pause 14 days before it runs out
steps: List live ads with creator content
Match each to its rights end date
Flag any ending within 14 days
Renew the winners and pause the rest before the date
Log each renewal with the new end date
jobs.output: a weekly rights list with renew or pause on each ad

watch.metric: live creator ads past their rights date

jobs.job: Check every partner post for claims we cannot back and wrong logo use, before it goes live and 48 hours after

inputs.need: allowed and forbidden claims with proof

steps: Read the caption and script against allowed claims
Check the paid partner label is there
Check the logo and product shots follow the brand kit
Send exact fixes before posting, or within 48 hours if already live
Log any repeat problem on the roster
jobs.output: a checked post with fixes sent and logged

watch.metric: partner posts with an unbacked claim or no label

jobs.drives: no platform strike or FTC letter

jobs.job: Compute Amazon ad profit per ASIN after fees, product cost and ads, and cut bids where ads lose money

inputs.need: Sponsored Products and Brands spend and sales by ASIN
Amazon fees per unit and payout
total Amazon sales per ASIN, ad and organic

steps: Pull 30 days of ad spend and total sales per ASIN
Compute profit per unit after fees and cost, then after ads
Set a break-even ad cost per sale per ASIN
Cut bids on campaigns over break-even and raise on those well under
Founder sees the list of ASINs that lose money with ads on
jobs.output: a per-ASIN table: profit before ads, ad cost, profit after ads, and the bid action

watch.metric: Amazon profit after ads per ASIN

jobs.job: Harvest Amazon search terms: move terms that sell from auto campaigns into exact match, and block terms with 15 clicks and no sale

inputs.need: profit per unit per ASIN, for the break-even line

steps: Pull search terms with clicks, orders and cost
Add terms with 2 or more orders under break-even to exact match campaigns
Add terms with 15 or more clicks and no order as negative exact
A person checks the negatives do not block a real product use
Send the top 10 converting terms to the signal bridge for Meta and Google
jobs.output: an updated exact list, a negative list, and 10 terms passed to other channels

watch.metric: Amazon ad spend on terms with no sale

jobs.job: Split Amazon ad spend into brand defence and new shoppers, and set a bid ceiling from profit per unit for Prime Day and Q4
jobs.trigger: monthly, and 3 weeks before Prime Day and Black Friday
steps: Tag each term brand or non-brand
Show spend, sales and new-to-brand orders for each side
Set a bid ceiling per ASIN from profit per unit for peak weeks
Cap brand defence bids where no rival shows on our name
Read after the peak: profit per unit, not ad sales
jobs.output: a brand vs new shopper split and a peak bid ceiling per ASIN

watch.metric: new-to-brand orders share

jobs.drives: new Amazon buyers at a profit

jobs.job: Pause ads on hero ASINs when FBA stock falls under 3 weeks or when another seller holds the buy box

inputs.need: FBA stock and 14 day sales rate

steps: Compute weeks of FBA stock per hero ASIN
Lower bids at 3 weeks and pause at 10 days, unless an inbound lands first
Pause ads on any ASIN where we lost the buy box
Resume when stock or the buy box is back
Log each pause with dollars not spent
jobs.output: a daily pause and resume list with the reason for each

watch.metric: ad spend on ASINs with no buy box or low stock

jobs.job: Feed Amazon reviews, questions and search terms into Meta hooks and site copy, and send Meta's winning angles into Amazon images and A+ content

inputs.need: rival Amazon reviews for 3 top listings

steps: Group our reviews and questions by love, hate, wish and doubt
Do the same for 3 rivals and list where they fail
Write 10 Meta hooks from the top themes in buyers' words
Rework the first 3 listing images and A+ blocks around the 2 best Meta angles
Track Meta hook results and Amazon conversion rate for 4 weeks
jobs.output: a theme sheet, 10 hooks for Meta and a new image and A+ set for the hero listing

watch.metric: Amazon unit session percentage on the hero listing

jobs.drives: sales on Amazon and Meta from the same words

jobs.job: Match each month's ad invoices from Meta, Google, TikTok and Amazon to reported spend and budget before they are paid, and chase every credit owed

inputs.need: spend by day per ad account
inputs.from: Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, Amazon Ads

steps: Pull spend per platform for the month
Match each invoice or card charge to spend
Flag gaps over 2 percent and any spend over budget
Open a ticket for each gap or missing credit
Follow each open ticket weekly until paid, and log the dollars back
jobs.output: a monthly spend and invoice table with open disputes and dollars recovered

watch.metric: invoice dollars not matched to spend

jobs.job: Read how much Meta spend lifts Amazon: compare Amazon brand searches and sales in weeks Meta spend rose or fell, then hold out one region to confirm

inputs.need: Meta spend by week and region
Amazon brand search volume and sales by week
founder sign-off on a 4 week region holdout

steps: Line up 26 weeks of Meta spend with Amazon brand searches and sales
Mark weeks where Meta spend moved more than 30 percent
Compare Amazon sales in those weeks with the weeks around them
If the link looks real, run a 4 week region holdout on Meta
Write the share of Amazon sales Meta seems to drive, with its range
jobs.output: a halo read with a range, and a keep or cut note for Meta budget

watch.metric: Amazon brand search volume in holdout vs control regions

jobs.drives: total sales across site and Amazon

jobs.job: Say yes or no to a new ad channel pitch (Walmart, Target, programmatic, Instacart) by checking 4 gates, and set a test budget with a stop line
jobs.trigger: each time a new channel pitches

inputs.need: current retargeting reach and frequency on Meta and Google
profit per unit on the channel after its fees
the offer and credits in writing

steps: Check the 4 gates: core ads profitable, retargeting not full, margin covers fees, stock covers demand
If a gate fails, write a no with the reason
If all pass, set a 6 week test budget, a stop line and the store number that judges it
Founder signs
Read at 6 weeks against the stop line
jobs.output: a yes or no memo, and for a yes a 6 week test plan with a stop line

watch.metric: store sales per dollar on the new channel

jobs.drives: no money on channels that cannot pay back

new_enablers.name: Partner commission ledger
new_enablers.what: One row per affiliate or creator commission, joined to the store order: new or returning buyer, returned or cancelled, coupon code source, time from click to order, and fraud signs such as the same address or card. Holds payout until each row is clean.
inputs: affiliate network or creator platform commission report
store orders with codes, refunds and new vs returning
coupon site scans for our codes
powers: pay only for kept, real, new sales
commission rates by new buyer share
claw back on refunds after payout
code leaks and brand-term bidding caught

new_enablers.name: Paid media spend ledger
new_enablers.what: One table of spend per platform per day from every ad account, next to the invoice, the budget and the store's view of sales. Flags invoice gaps, invalid click credits owed and platforms over budget.
powers: one paid media total against budget
a fair test budget for a new channel
